import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import subprocess
import urllib.request

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
bench = root / 'docs/benchmarks'
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
desc = lambda path: {'path': str(Path(path).relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(path)}
read = lambda name: json.loads((bench / f'2026-10-16-accept-fairness-{name}.json').read_text())
meta = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/accept-fairness-candidate.json').read_text())
driver = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/accept-fairness-driver.json').read_text())
revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
assert subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--quiet', meta['source_revision'], 'HEAD', '--', 'src', 'vendor', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'], cwd=root).returncode == 0
changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--numstat', meta['baseline']['revision'], meta['source_revision'], '--', 'src', 'vendor', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
assert changed == '1\t1\tsrc/server.rs'
for name, digest in meta['sources'].items():
    assert sha(root / name) == sha(root / meta['directory'] / name) == digest
for name, digest in meta['binaries'].items():
    assert sha(root / meta['directory'] / name) == sha(root / 'target/release' / name) == digest
for snapshot in [meta['helper'], driver]:
    for name, digest in snapshot['sources'].items():
        assert sha(root / snapshot['directory'] / name) == digest
for name, digest in driver['sources'].items():
    assert sha(root / name) == digest

def empty(metrics):
    for name in ['war_connections', 'war_sessions', 'war_queued_bytes', 'war_variable_bytes',
                 'war_output_queue_capacity_bytes', 'war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes']:
        assert int(metrics[name]) == 0, (name, metrics[name])
    assert int(metrics['war_channels']) == 1

def admission(data, binary, profile=False):
    assert data['passed'] and data['server_sha256'] == binary and data['profile_diagnostic'] == profile
    assert data['server_exit_code'] == data['client_exit_code'] == 0
    assert all(code == 0 for code in data['client_exit_codes'].values())
    assert [e['event'] for e in data['events']] == ['ready', 'measured', 'done']
    for event in data['events']:
        assert all(event['metrics'][name] == value for name, value in event['exact_counter_checks'].items())
        assert event['metrics']['war_routing_copied_bytes_total'] == 0
    empty(data['events'][-1]['metrics'])

comparison = read('comparison')
assert comparison['passed'] and len(comparison['cases']) == 42
assert comparison['candidate']['sources'] == meta['sources'] and comparison['driver'] == driver
assert comparison['variants']['before']['sha256'] == meta['baseline']['sha256']
assert comparison['variants']['selected']['sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert comparison['client']['sha256'] == meta['helper']['client_sha256']
for item in [*comparison['variants'].values(), comparison['client']]:
    assert sha(root / item['path']) == item['sha256']
for row in comparison['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['sha256'] and row['exit_code'] == 0
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()); admission(data, comparison['variants'][row['kind']]['sha256'])
    assert data['client_sha256'] == comparison['client']['sha256'] and data['isolated_namespace']
    assert data['args']['workers'] == row['workers'] and data['args']['flood_workers'] == row['flood_workers']
    assert len(data['listener_queues_before']) == row['workers']
    assert all(queue['backlog'] == 1024 for queue in data['listener_queues_before'])
totals = {role: {name: sum(row['tcp_counter_delta'][name] for row in comparison['cases'] if row['kind'] == role)
                  for name in ['ListenDrops', 'TCPSynRetrans']} for role in comparison['variants']}
pilot = read('pilot'); assert pilot['passed'] and len(pilot['cases']) == 32
for role, candidate in pilot['candidates']['variants'].items():
    for name, digest in candidate['sources'].items():
        assert sha(root / candidate['directory'] / name) == digest
    for name, digest in candidate['binaries'].items():
        assert sha(root / candidate['directory'] / name) == digest
for row in pilot['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['sha256'] and row['exit_code'] == 0
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()); admission(data, pilot['variants'][row['quantum']]['binaries']['war-relay'])
guard = read('routing-guard'); assert guard['passed'] and len(guard['cases']) == 12
for row in guard['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['trace_sha256']
    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert data['passed'] and not data['profile_diagnostic'] and not data['server_forced_kill']
    assert data['server_exit_code'] == data['client_exit_code'] == 0
    assert data['server_sha256'] == guard['variants'][row['kind']]['sha256']
    assert data['client_sha256'] == guard['client']['sha256']
    assert data['client_source_root'] == str(root / 'artifacts/baselines/fanout-probe')
    for event in data['events']:
        assert event['metrics']['war_routing_copied_bytes_total'] == 0
        assert event['metrics']['war_accept_errors_total'] == event['metrics']['war_setup_errors_total'] == 0
    empty(data['events'][-1]['metrics'])
for name, digest in guard['client']['source_hashes'].items():
    assert sha(root / 'artifacts/baselines/fanout-probe' / name) == digest
burst = read('burst-guard'); assert burst['passed'] and len(burst['cases']) == 6
for row in burst['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['trace_sha256']
    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert data['passed'] and not data['profile_diagnostic'] and not data['server_forced_kill']
    assert data['server_exit_code'] == data['client_exit_code'] == 0
    assert data['server_sha256'] == comparison['variants'][row['kind']]['sha256']
    assert data['client_sha256'] == guard['client']['sha256']
    assert data['args']['workers'] == 1 and data['args']['churn_workers'] == 64
    empty(data['events'][-1]['metrics'])
for role in comparison['variants']:
    upper = read('upper-' + role); admission(upper, comparison['variants'][role]['sha256'])
    assert upper['args']['flood_workers'] == 1024 and upper['isolated_namespace']
    for workers in [1, 4]:
        data = read(f'stop-{role}-w{workers}')
        assert data['passed'] and data['native_exit_code'] == 0 and data['flood_exit_code'] == 1
        assert not data.get('native_forced_kill') and not data.get('flood_forced_kill')
        assert data['shutdown_close'] == 1001 and data['verified_echoes_during_flood'] == 8
        assert data['server_sha256'] == comparison['variants'][role]['sha256']
profiles = read('profiles'); assert profiles['passed'] and len(profiles['cases']) == 2
for case in profiles['cases']:
    for name in ['trace', 'raw_data', 'published_report']:
        assert sha(root / case[name]['path']) == case[name]['sha256']
    assert case['lost'] == 0 and case['samples'] > 0
    data = json.loads((root / case['trace']['path']).read_text())
    admission(data, comparison['variants'][case['kind']]['sha256'], True)
    assert data['profile_sha256'] == case['raw_data']['sha256']
    assert data['perf_exit_code'] in [0, -2]
helper_check = read('helper-check'); admission(helper_check, meta['baseline']['sha256'])

stress = read('stability'); assert stress['passed'] and len(stress['cases']) == 4
assert stress['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
for case in stress['cases']:
    assert case['passed'] and case['server_exit_code'] == case['exit_code'] == 0 and not case['server_forced_kill']
    assert case['cleaned_up'] and case['counts_match'] and case['pressure_valid']; empty(case['final']['metrics'])
upper = read('fanout-upper')
assert upper['passed'] and upper['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert upper['server_exit_code'] == upper['client_exit_code'] == 0 and not upper['server_forced_kill']
assert upper['args']['fanout_readers'] == 1024 and upper['mixed']['fanout_membership']['verified'] > 0
empty(upper['events'][-1]['metrics'])
accept, setup = read('accept'), read('setup')
assert accept['passed'] and len(accept['cases']) == 3 and accept['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert accept['bridge_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-legacy-bridge']
for case in accept['cases']:
    assert case['passed'] and case['pressure']['fd_count'] == 64 and all(code == 0 for code in case['process_exit_codes'])
assert setup['passed'] and setup['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay'] and len(setup['cases']) == 4
for case in setup['cases']:
    assert case['passed'] and case['process_exit_code'] == 0 and len(case['injected_calls']) == 3
    assert all(wave['slot_held_until_descriptor_close'] for wave in case['waves'])
reference, api, browser = read('reference'), read('api'), read('browser')
assert reference['passed'] and reference['common_cases'] == 48
assert reference['upstream_commit'] == '881c8daaf2cf05adea8f522b28cf372e8f82d4e9'
assert len(reference['results']['cpp']['intentional_differences']) == len(reference['results']['rust']['intentional_differences']) == 8
for role, name in [('native', 'war-relay'), ('bridge', 'war-legacy-bridge')]:
    assert reference[role]['sha256'] == meta['binaries'][name] and reference[role]['exit_code'] == 0
    live = browser['runtime'][role]
    assert sha(f'/proc/{live["pid"]}/exe') == live['sha256'] == meta['binaries'][name]
assert api['passed'] and len(api['checks']) == 4 and api['server_exit_code'] == 0; empty(api['final_metrics'])
assert api['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert [row['status'] for row in api['manual_admission_transitions']] == [401, 204, 200, 503, 200, 401, 204, 200]
assert browser['passed'] and len(browser['browser']['checks']) == 7 and not browser['browser']['errors']
assert browser['worker_listener_sockets'] == 4 and all(status == 200 for status in browser['health'].values()); empty(browser['metrics'])
assert browser['source_revision'] == meta['source_revision']
assert 'Total messages: 0 (Errors: 0, Warnings: 0)' in (root / 'artifacts/accept-fairness-browser-console.txt').read_text()
ci = read('ci'); admission(ci, sha(root / 'target/debug/war-relay'))
assert ci['client_sha256'] == sha(root / 'target/debug/examples/admission')
assert not any(ci['args'][name] for name in ['server_cpus', 'client_cpus', 'flood_cpus'])
verification = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/accept-fairness-verification.json').read_text())
assert verification['passed'] and len(verification['steps']) == 16
for step in verification['steps']:
    assert step['exit_code'] == 0 and sha(root / step['log']) == step['sha256']
tests = (root / 'artifacts/accept-fairness-tests.log').read_text()
suites = [int(value) for value in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed;', tests) if int(value)]
assert sum(suites) == 138 and 'test result: FAILED' not in tests
clippy = (root / 'artifacts/accept-fairness-clippy.log').read_text()
release = (root / 'artifacts/accept-fairness-release.log').read_text()
js = (root / 'artifacts/accept-fairness-js.log').read_text()
assert 'Finished' in clippy and 'warning:' not in clippy and 'Finished' in release
assert 'pass 6' in js and 'pass 1' in js and 'fail 0' in js
checks = {'source_revision': revision, 'runtime_implementation_revision': meta['source_revision'],
          'rust': {'command': ['cargo', 'test', '--locked', '--all-targets'], 'passed': 138, 'suites': suites, 'exit_code': 0, 'output': tests},
          'clippy': {'exit_code': 0, 'output': clippy}, 'release': {'exit_code': 0, 'output': release},
          'javascript': {'passed': 7, 'exit_code': 0, 'output': js}, 'verification': verification, 'small_checks': []}
for command in [['cargo', 'fmt', '--check'], ['python3', '-m', 'py_compile', 'scripts/admission-flood.py'], ['python3', 'scripts/check-vendor.py']]:
    done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True); assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
    checks['small_checks'].append({'command': command, 'exit_code': 0, 'output': done.stdout + done.stderr})
(bench / '2026-10-16-accept-fairness-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(checks, indent=2) + '\n')

tracked = lambda *paths: subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', *paths], cwd=root, text=True).splitlines()
runtime = tracked('src', 'vendor', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock')
helpers = tracked('scripts', 'examples', 'tests', 'clients/js', '.github/workflows/rust.yml')
extra = [root / 'artifacts' / name for name in ['build-accept-fairness-candidates.py', 'accept-fairness-pilot.py', 'accept-fairness-study.py',
    'accept-fairness-routing-guard.py', 'accept-fairness-burst-guard.py', 'accept-fairness-verify.py', 'accept-fairness-stability.py', 'accept-fairness-api.py',
    'refresh-accept-fairness-runtime.py', 'record-accept-fairness-browser.py', 'record-accept-fairness-profiles.py', 'record-accept-fairness-checkpoint.py', 'paging-accept.mjs']]
evidence = [desc(path) for path in sorted(bench.glob('2026-10-16-accept-fairness-*.json'))
            if path.name != '2026-10-16-accept-fairness-build.json']
with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:1339/metrics', timeout=3) as response:
    live_metrics = {key: int(value) for key, value in (line.split() for line in response.read().decode().splitlines() if line.startswith('war_'))}
empty(live_metrics)
queues = subprocess.check_output(['ss', '-H', '-ltn', 'sport = :1338'], text=True).splitlines()
assert len(queues) == 4 and all(int(row.split()[2]) == 1024 for row in queues)
record = {'passed': True, 'source_revision': revision, 'runtime_implementation_revision': meta['source_revision'],
          'driver_source_revision': driver['source_revision'], 'candidate': meta, 'driver': driver,
          'platform': platform.platform(), 'rustc': subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '--version'], text=True).strip(),
          'scope': 'Local Linux checkpoint. Only native runtime change is accept quantum64->16 at the same1024 backlog.32 exploratory tuning cases;42 retained three-round admission comparisons and18 private/admitted-reconnect guards run sequentially without builds, profiles, injected faults or competing loads. Full body/FIFO/Close/EOF, exact counters and retirement verify. CPU figures span a changing work mix and are not a per-operation efficiency or general speedup claim. Profiles and stress run separately; perf user cycles do not resolve kernel costs, and gated CPU accounting provides user/system totals. Hosted CI/deployment and production capacity unverified. Goal remains active.',
          'runtime_sources': [desc(root / name) for name in runtime],
          'documentation': [desc(root / name) for name in ['README.md', 'docs/STATUS.md', 'docs/operations.md', 'docs/performance.md', 'docs/stability.md']],
          'helpers_and_tests': [desc(root / name) for name in helpers] + [desc(path) for path in extra],
          'frozen_runtime': [desc(root / meta['directory'] / name) for name in meta['binaries']],
          'clients': [desc(root / meta['helper']['directory'] / 'admission'), desc(root / 'artifacts/baselines/fanout-probe/inspection'),
                      desc(root / 'artifacts/baselines/room-churn-client/inspection'), desc(root / 'artifacts/baselines/address-churn-client/stress')],
          'controller_snapshots': [desc(root / driver['directory'] / name) for name in driver['sources']],
          'client_source_snapshot': {name: sha(root / meta['helper']['directory'] / name) for name in meta['helper']['sources']},
          'evidence': evidence, 'kernel_counter_totals': totals, 'profiles': profiles,
          'browser_screenshot': browser['screenshot'], 'browser_assets': browser['browser_assets'],
          'live_listener_rows': queues, 'live_metrics': live_metrics,
          'manual_services': json.loads((root / 'artifacts/reactor-manual-services.json').read_text()),
          'collector_source': Path(__file__).read_text()}
(bench / '2026-10-16-accept-fairness-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'source': revision, 'runtime': meta['source_revision'], 'rust': 138,
                  'ordinary_cases': 60, 'pilot_cases': 32, 'runtime_sources': len(runtime), 'helpers_and_tests': len(record['helpers_and_tests']), 'evidence': len(evidence)}))
